name: check
title: Check
description: A success badge that draws its circle and checkmark with a satisfying stroke animation.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels.

props.name: active
props.description: Controlled drawn state. When omitted the icon manages its own state.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Called when the badge is replayed.

accessibility: Renders as a button with an accessible label. Clicking replays the draw animation, which is decorative and conveys no essential information.
touch: Hover scale is gated behind a (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) check. Tapping replays the draw directly.
reducedMotion: The draw is skipped; the badge fades in with a short 150ms opacity transition.
